name: Volshebnaya svadba guslyara Ivana
source:
The Wondrous Wedding of Ivan the Bard is a nonlinear visual novel set in medieval Russia, blending historical accuracy with fantasy elements. You don't play as a knight, a bogatyr, or a mercenary.

Your hero is a simple young man with a gusli, so his only weapons are eloquence and music. A single careless word can turn a conversation hostile. One well-chosen reply can set a girl's heart aflutter. Converse, play the gusli, make friends, enemies, and lovers, and lead Ivan to one of several possible endings.

***

Novgorod, 13th century. Ivan is a humble gusli player who has come to the city to seek his fortune and find a bride. One day, he falls in love with the prince's daughter and dreams of marrying her, but the dream seems impossible—nothing ever goes Ivan’s way. At his lowest point, fate gives him a chance. Now, Ivan will live through a summer full of adventures in a magical Novgorod, uncover the mysteries of the female heart, win the princess’s love, and gain wealth and fame. But is it possible to have it all? Perhaps the series of choices will lead the hero to a very different destiny.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3681690/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《吟游诗人伊凡的奇妙婚礼》是一部以中世纪俄罗斯为背景的非线性视觉小说，融合了历史准确性和奇幻元素。你扮演的角色不是骑士、勇士或雇佣兵。

你的英雄是一个拿着古斯里琴的简单年轻人，所以他唯一的武器就是口才和音乐。一个不小心的词就会使谈话变得充满敌意。一个精心挑选的回复可以让女孩心潮澎湃。交谈、弹奏古斯里琴、结交朋友、敌人和恋人，并引导伊万走向几种可能的结局之一。

***

诺夫哥罗德，13世纪。伊万是一位卑微的古斯里琴演奏家，他来到这座城市寻求财富并寻找新娘。有一天，他爱上了王子的女儿，并梦想娶她为妻，但这个梦想似乎不可能实现——一切都不如伊万所愿。在他最低谷的时候，命运给了他一个机会。现在，伊万将在神奇的诺夫哥罗德度过一个充满冒险的夏天，揭开女性内心的奥秘，赢得公主的爱情，获得财富和名誉。但有可能拥有这一切吗？或许这一系列的选择，将带领主人公走向截然不同的命运。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3681690/]Steam[/url]]
